packageRules.description: Boot pins the jOOQ runtime; the codegen plugin and meta-extensions must match it (build.gradle). Dep names: a Gradle plugin's package name is <id>:<id>.gradle.plugin, which matchPackageNames misses.
prBodyNotes: 影响 AOT/Native：合并后、发布前在 main 上手动运行 ci，确认 native 通过。

packageRules.description: Native toolchain: only the manually dispatched native job exercises it.
prBodyNotes: 只有手动触发的 native job 会用到：合并后、发布前在 main 上手动运行 ci，确认 native 通过。

packageRules.description: The conformance suite's images: one PR, majors included; the PR runs the conformance workflow (paths filter).
prBodyNotes: 这些镜像只有 conformance workflow 会用到；本 PR 会自动跑 conformance，合并前确认它通过。

packageRules.description: Stay on the MongoDB major the suite's own docker-compose uses. mongo 9.0.4 also refuses to start on kernels 6.19-7.0.13 (SERVER-121912), which the iam-build runner (pve1) is on.
The conformance browser image must match @playwright/test (scripts/conformance); after the conformance rule so it wins.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned at line ends in scripts/ (image=repo:tag, or before a line continuation).
The Playwright image: v-prefixed tag with an OS suffix and a trailing comment, which the rule above skips.
